verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships first-party iOS and Android SDKs: the iOS SDK detects app hangs (docs-33), both SDKs are named in docs-35, and a hands-on user says the iOS SDK reports fatal errors automatically (comm-2). Device and release context appear indirectly through device-correlated events (docs-20) and release filtering (docs-4). Missing for 10: any NDK/native C/C++ crash evidence, explicit documentation of Android crash capture, explicit capture of device/OS/app-version metadata on crash events, and in-depth platform docs for native crash handling.
